test_title: PYST 27: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, L, M, N, O, W, X and Y, are sitting in a row, facing north (but not necessarily in the same order). Only five people sit between W and X. N sits to the immediate left of X. Only one person sits between N and L. M sits at some place to the left of O but at some place to the right of Y. Who sits third from the left end of the line?
solution:
Given:

Seven people, L, M, N, O, W, X and Y, are sitting in a row, facing north.

Only five people sit between W and X.

N sits to the immediate left of X.

Only one person sits between N and L.

M sits at some place to the left of O but at some place to the right of Y. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1afc58b53ca5e460a7332a3b552ecce623e347f856d9339c30c1ccfb1ca32ea7.png] 

Thus, M sits third from the left end of the line.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
